prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: panoramic background artwork for the PN Ragnarok launcher and matching server status page. Create a richly painted, premium fantasy MMORPG landscape inspired by Ragnarok Online's Midgard and Prontera: a graceful pale-stone medieval cathedral city with warm red and blue roofs, elegant towers, the far-off canopy of Yggdrasil, lush fields, a flowing river, and soft distant mountains. Enchanting classic fantasy anime game illustration, fine painterly lighting, celestial atmosphere, adventurous and inviting, polished and detailed rather than a cartoon icon or a photorealistic film. Ultra-wide horizontal composition intended as a shallow launcher banner, approximately 3:1 aspect ratio. Put the beautiful city, graceful cathedral towers and an airy sunlit canopy mostly in the right 60 percent; the left 40 percent is dark quiet midnight-blue woodland and mist with plenty of calm negative space for interface text. Palette midnight navy, slate teal, warm champagne gold sun rays, subtle ivory highlights. Golden late-afternoon light from the upper-right, gentle cyan magical motes around the river, no flashy glowing weapons. Keep main architecture around the central horizontal band so shallow cropping still looks beautiful. No characters in close-up, no logos, no writing, no typography, no borders, no UI controls, no watermark. This is background art only, to pair with a refined gold-and-ivory Valkyrie/Yggdrasil PN crest.
purpose: PN launcher and LAN realm status page
